answer: This system charges each identity rent of 10 units every 30 days from its own locked balance, never shared, so a clone that earns nothing drains its operator. Rent stays current only after an audit: the holder plants one yarrow stem, waits 14 days while a glacier melt channel waters it at 2 liters per day, then harvests it in an orchard plot where its height is measured against the planting height; growth under 10 centimeters or a missing stem voids the payment and freezes the identity, so 100 fakes need 100 rents and 100 14-day waits.
